messages:
Caroline Wu: quick check-in — i've been cleaning up a bunch of pages and noticed we use four different terms for the same thing: 'kv cache', 'prefix cache', 'context cache', and 'token cache'. that's confusing for readers and for SDK params. any preference for canonical term?
Ezra Kim: +1 we should pick one. i vote for 'KV cache' (capitalize KV, spell out 'key-value' on first mention). it's the most precise. e.g., 'KV cache (key-value cache)'.
Tom Alvarez: agree on KV cache. with a parenthetical helps non-hardware folks. also +1 to add a short explainer sentence: "The KV cache stores past key/value activations to accelerate autoregressive decoding."
Rhea Mehta: from an API surface perspective, booleans like `use_cache=True` are too noisy. propose a tiny enum for SDKs: `cache_policy = 'none' | 'prefill' | 'kv'` where 'prefill' is for prefix-only caching and 'kv' means full KV caching. that covers future strategies.
Caroline Wu: good call. proposal: canonical doc wording = 'KV cache' for the feature, and `cache_policy` as the SDK param. examples: python uses `cache_policy='kv'`, JS uses `cachePolicy: 'kv'`.
Ezra Kim: migration note: we still have snippets using `use_kv_cache=True` and `prefix_cache=True`. add a migration shim that maps old booleans:
```py
# shim (temporary)
def normalize_cache_kwargs(kwargs):
    if kwargs.pop('use_kv_cache', False):
        kwargs.setdefault('cache_policy', 'kv')
    elif kwargs.pop('prefix_cache', False):
        kwargs.setdefault('cache_policy', 'prefill')
    return kwargs
```
Tom Alvarez: that looks safe. add deprecation message text: "Deprecated: 'use_kv_cache' and 'prefix_cache' will be removed in 6 months. Use 'cache_policy' instead." put this in /docs/migration/cache-params.md.
Rhea Mehta: docs action items: 1) glossary entry for 'KV cache' and 'prefill/prefix caching' — i'll own that. 2) update SDK snippets under /docs/sdk/ — Ez will take those. 3) add migration page with shim + deprecation text — Tom will write that. 4) add a docs-lint rule to flag the older tokens 'prefix cache' and 'context cache' — Caroline?
Caroline Wu: yep i'll add a lint rule and a quick grep+fix for docs pages. will include frontmatter synonyms so search still finds 'context cache' -> `kv cache`. e.g., `search_synonyms: ["context cache","prefix cache","token cache"]`.
docs-bot: Auto: created issue #1407 "glossary: KV cache canonicalization + SDK cache_policy param" (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/1407).
Ezra Kim: tiny wording nit: in prose use 'KV cache' capitalized, but in code examples use lowercase string values "kv"/"prefill". also preserve python snake_case + JS camelCase for param names.
Tom Alvarez: timeline check: Ez will open the SDK snippets PR by Wed EOD; Rhea will open the glossary PR by Thu; i'll add the migration doc + changelog blurb by Fri; Caroline will add the lint rule and redirects in a follow-up PR.
Rhea Mehta: i'll include an example sentence in glossary: "KV cache (key-value cache): a per-request store of cached attention keys/values used to avoid recomputing prefixes and speed up generation." keep it short.
Caroline Wu: one more UX note: Console microcopy currently says 'Enable prefix caching' in a toggle. we'll change UI text to 'Use KV cache (prefill only)' depending on the mode; frontend team will land a tooltip change. i've pinged @frontend for a tiny tooltip PR.
Ezra Kim: thanks. last Q: anyone object to using 'cache_policy' as the SDK param name?
Tom Alvarez: no objections. LGTM :thumbsup:
Caroline Wu: sounds good. i'll add a checklist to the issue and close thread when all PRs merge. /me adds checklist to issue: [ ] SDK snippets, [ ] glossary, [ ] migration doc, [ ] lint rule, [ ] console tooltip
